Name: Medieval Craftables for Cornucopia - Artisan Machines
Author: pray3rz
Description:
Here are some [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url] ﻿Craftables ﻿Retexture/Recolor that match to [b]Gwen's ﻿medieval mods[/b].[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]
[/url]
[b][u]Features:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]﻿﻿Alembic
[*]﻿Butter Churn
[*]﻿Compact Mill
[*]﻿Drying Rack
[*]﻿Extruder
[*]﻿Juicer
[*]﻿Vinegar Keg
[*]﻿Wax Barrel
[*]﻿Yogurt Jar 
[/list]
[b][u]Config Option:
[/u][/b]All items can be turned on or off in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] so I highly recommend downloading this.

[b]withoutIcon[/b](false by default): Allow to remove icon.(if people like its, supported ﻿Butter Churn and Vinegar Keg only.)

[b][u]Install:[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]﻿Install ﻿[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]﻿Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url]﻿.
[*](Option) Download and the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]Download the latest version of this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[CP] Medieval Craftables for Cornucopia - Artisan Machines' folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
[*]﻿You're done; run the game using SMAPI!
[/list]
For AT version you must be install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.

[u][b]Huge Credits/Thanks:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Cornucopia Team(﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/55537262]6480[/url]﻿, ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/158706123]DraconisLeonidas[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/EnderTedi/about-me?gameId=1303]EnderTedi[/url]﻿) for making the wonderful Cornucopia mods!
[*][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Gweniaczek/about-me]Gweniaczek[/url]﻿﻿ for making the medieval mods! And ﻿﻿the mod mostly inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables[/url]﻿.
[/list]
